58: Rabbi Yehudah said: From here [we learn that] any division that is for the sake of heaven will in the end be preserved. As behold, here you have division that was for the sake of heaven and heaven was preserved by it after it. As it is written: And God called the firmament, heaven, etc. (Genesis 1:8). With a chamber and an attic, the beams [of the ceiling] hold up [the attic] and it is preserved. For we have learned, "It is written: so that the curtain shall serve you as a partition between the Holy and the Holy of Holies (Exodus 26:33) — be precise, behold it is this firmament that separates in the middle."
